The rates for curbside collection are as follows: $94.76 per month for a 20-gallon garbage cart, $100.41 per month for a 35-gallon garbage cart, $138.33 per month for a 65-gallon garbage cart, and $154.91 per month for a 95-gallon garbage cart. Each residential account includes unlimited recycling and organics carts. On-premises (backyard) collection rates are different and are limited to a maximum size of 35 gallons. For residents of Madison County, NY, there is no charge for residential yard waste drop-off if the items are up to 6 inches in diameter and no longer than 10 feet in length. Commercial yard waste, stumps, and oversized tree limbs are charged per ton and must go over the scales before unloading.

Hazardous waste, on the other hand, refers to any household material that is toxic or corrosive, or can catch fire, react or explode under certain conditions. Examples include bleaches, cleaning solvents, pesticides, pool chemicals and more.
